preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 300,000.
The length of the string s matches the given integer n.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= char <= 'z' for char in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES l r' where l and r are integers.
If the output is 'YES', the indices l and r satisfy 1 <= l < r <= n.
Reversing the substring s[l-1:r] results in a string that is lexicographically less than s.
